fact: An ACSI mission of 25 to 29 October 2022 to Ignié, Kinkala and Matoumbou found civil-status declarations at the urban community and commune offices handled on paper registers and carried in by hand, village chiefs walking them to the centre, with computerisation of civil status in communes, urban communities, districts and departments only inscribed in ACSI's programme and data-entry centres only proposed; it names no system or connection in use at these offices.
title: Mission du Projet Système Intégré des Faits d’Etat Civil (SIFEC) à Ignié, Kinkala et Matoumbou (Département du Pool)
